causes.no_text: No usable text (blank scan, caption only, bare cross-reference)
causes.ocr_failure: Parse/OCR failure (garbled headword or text, invented text)
causes.obsolete_or_minor: Obsolete or historical concept, or a subject too minor for its own Wikipedia article
causes.pool_miss: Candidate pool miss: the right article exists but retrieval never returned it
causes.threshold_miss: Threshold miss: the right article is top 1 but the scores are below the accept rules
causes.other: Other (ranking miss, segmentation error, tables, unclear subject)
